title: Children of a depth-two node have depth at most one
statement: Let $g = \mathrm{node}(\mathit{isAnd}, cs)$ be a Boolean circuit consisting of a single gate (an AND gate if $\mathit{isAnd}$ is true, an OR gate otherwise) applied to a list $cs$ of child circuits, and suppose its depth satisfies $\mathrm{depth}(g) \le 2$. Then every child circuit $c$ in $cs$ has depth $\mathrm{depth}(c) \le 1$.
hypotheses_covered: the circuit is a gate node node(isAnd, cs) with child list cs
the gate's depth is at most 2
replaced:
If a gate node $\mathrm{node}\,\mathit{isAnd}\,cs$ has depth at most $2$, then every child
$c\in cs$ has depth at most $1$.
